verdict.rationale: cubic documents a 'memory and learning' feature that extracts learnings from experienced reviewers' historical PR comments, which shows the review agent builds persistent knowledge. The evidence describes only onboarding-time extraction from selected reviewers, not ongoing automatic memory building and recall across sessions. The auto-maintained AI wiki is codebase indexing rather than agent memory, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous automatic memory capture from ongoing interactions, documentation of how memories are recalled in later reviews or sessions, memory management or visibility controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: cubic analyzes their historical PR comments to extract learnings from the patterns they consistently enforce.
